**H0-b VCS port verbs + two-key split implementation (issue #266)**

**What**: Implemented Group B (H0-b) of issue #266 in worktree /home/gandalf/IA/brain-issue-266-h0b, branch feat/issue-266-h0b-port-verbs-two-key-split: four COMMENT-only VCS port verbs (prReviewComment/issueComment/labelAdd/labelRemove) on github.mjs + gitlab.mjs, cli.mjs VERBS + vcs-contract.md updates, L6 governance.reviewActors wiring in brain-writes-reviewed.mjs, and the two mandatory lock-3 tests (REQ-266-6 t1/t2). Strict TDD (RED observed first via npm test, then GREEN). 3 commits: f5ed833 (port verbs), 62ed257 (L6 wiring + lock-3 tests), 6a0f9e9 (tasks.md housekeeping). Final: npm test 1471/1471 green, npm run repo:check clean, ~210 production lines (github.mjs +78, gitlab.mjs +108, cli.mjs +5, vcs-contract.md +6/-2, brain-writes-reviewed.mjs +15/-2) — above the ~120-180 estimate but well under the 400 budget, no size:exception needed.

**Why**: issue #266 phase H0 needs a cold external reviewer that can post COMMENT-only verdicts and never reach an APPROVE code path (three structural locks), with L5/L6 gates split so the reviewer's registration key never feeds both an authorization gate (L5, permissive) and an exclusion gate (L6, restrictive) simultaneously.

**Where**: brain/scripts/vcs/providers/{github,gitlab}.mjs, brain/scripts/vcs/cli.mjs, brain/core/methodology/vcs-contract.md, brain/scripts/vcs/brain-writes-reviewed.mjs, brain/scripts/vcs/{actor-check,brain-writes-reviewed}.test.mjs, brain/scripts/vcs/providers/vcs.contract.test.mjs, openspec/changes/issue-266-h0a-reviewer-protocol-doctrine/tasks.md.

**Learned**: 1) Design ambiguity flagged (not blocking): design.md §3's table lists L6's key as "governance.reviewActors (new)" singular, which reads as a replace of the existing governance.approvalActors read; but the H0-b task instruction says "threads it into its botAllowlist" (additive). Resolved as UNION (approvalActors ∪ reviewActors) — safer, satisfies both mandatory lock-3 tests under either reading, and doesn't regress existing approvalActors-driven L6 exclusion. Neither key is populated in brain.config.json today so no live behavior differs yet — flagged for reviewer awareness in tasks.md's Hot micro-decisions. 2) t1 (L5 lock-3 test) required NO production code change since L5/actor-check.mjs is intentionally untouched by design — the test was written first and observed GREEN immediately (not a real RED→GREEN pair), which is correct per design but worth noting for verify-phase TDD-evidence review. 3) Task 7.3 (populating governance.reviewActors with a real reviewer bot handle) is deliberately deferred — no reviewer bot identity exists yet; brain.config.json is untouched. 4) GitLab's notes API (used for prReviewComment/issueComment) has no review-event/web_url field — url is derived by stripping /api/v4 from apiBase and appending #note_{id}; labelAdd/labelRemove on GitLab target the issues endpoint only (PUT .../issues/{n} with add_labels/remove_labels), matching the pre-existing labelEvents issues-only precedent on that provider (GitLab MRs are a separate resource, not covered). 5) Fixture-free contract tests: rather than adding new fixtures/*.json files (which would count against the diff budget since fixtures aren't in governance.ignoreList), the four new verbs use inline setSpawn/fetchImpl mocks directly in vcs.contract.test.mjs.
